nodes.label: Sorcerer Vocation Icon (arcane wand with purple orb)
nodes.description: Colored pixel-art icon of a golden wand/scepter whose crescent head cradles a glowing purple orb, surrounded by pink and violet sparkle pixels. Depicts the Sorcerer vocation (offensive arcane caster class). Belongs to the Thaira vocation/class system; same chunky RPG pixel-art style with dark outlines and drop shadow.
